Systematic Review

Abstract

This systematic review evaluated published studies concerning
the effectiveness of an intervention.

Methods

This systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA
guidelines. Published studies were identified through searches
of multiple electronic databases.

No human participants were directly recruited for this review.
The analysis was based entirely on previously published studies.

Results

Twenty-five published studies met the eligibility criteria
and were included in the systematic review.

Data Availability

All data analyzed during this systematic review were obtained
from previously published studies.
